lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: may I have a moment of your time?
Sure, what's up?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I am in need of a new place to practice shuriken throwing.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Yet, no suitable location comes to mind.
Where've you been training all this time?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I trained at the park.
It's dangerous to throw shurikens in the park.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: So, I trained secretly at night

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: in places with no one around.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: But more eyes were watching than I expected.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Not long ago, someone passing by thought I looked suspicious and reported me.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: So, the A.C.P.U. came.
The A.C.P.U.? Are you okay?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Fortunately,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I managed to escape before being caught.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: My phantom thief training seems to have helped.
That's a relief... I think.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: For that reason,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I can no longer use the park as a training ground.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: It was a good place to train,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: which is regrettable.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Therefore, I need a new location

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: where I can train without being disturbed.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Commander, do you happen to know of any such place?
I'll look into it.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Until then,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I shall train on the ceiling of the Commander's Room.
Wait a sec!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: What is the matter?
You're going to throw shurikens on my ceiling?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: The ceiling in the Commander's Room is quite spacious and quiet,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: and with no one else present, it is ideal for training.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: When the weather makes outdoor practice difficult,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I have trained on that ceiling.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I have done so a few times, and it proved quite effective.
I had no idea.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Stealth is the foundation of a ninja thief.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Naturally, I ensured that no sound or trace was left.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Seeing that even you were unaware of my presence,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: it seems my efforts were successful.
I'm not cool with it, so stop.
I'll find you a new place soon, so rest for now.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Very well,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I shall use this time to rest

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: and check whether there are any suitable locations nearby.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I will inform you should I find one.
I'll let you know if I find anything.
